title: Hip Abduction Machine
summary: A seated machine that pushes the legs apart, for the glute medius, glute minimus and TFL.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: commercial gym machine (this exercise's own machine).

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for abductors (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly abductors total.
Library rating 0.3 for glutes (minor): each working set adds 0.3 of a set to the weekly glutes total.

setup.text: Sit with the pads on the outside of your knees.
Push your knees out as far as you can.

form_cues.cue: Push the knees out against the pads
Leaning forward slightly works the glute medius more.

mistakes.text: Rocking the torso to push the pads out.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: One side at a time, Steadier cable tension.
Swap sheet: Less isolation, Less stable, One side at a time.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
